{"content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 定义所有字段 -->
    <sql id="columns">TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER,
    STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
    </sql>

    <!-- 插入单条记录 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE (<include refid="columns"/>)
        VALUES (
        #{templateId},
        #{templateName},
        #{remark},
        #{version},
        #{createDate},
        #{creator},
        #{modifyDate},
        #{modifier},
        #{status},
        #{templateType},
        #{cover},
        #{catalogs}
        )
    </insert>

    <!-- 查询所有报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectAll" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
    </select>

    <!-- 查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板名称查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateName" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATENAME = #{templateName}
    </select>

    <!-- 删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET
            TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            CREATEDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.createDate},
            CREATOR = #{reportTemplatePO.creator},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>


</mapper>

{"content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 定义所有字段 -->
    <sql id="columns">TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER,
    STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
    </sql>

    <!-- 插入单条记录 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE (<include refid="columns"/>)
        VALUES (
        #{templateId},
        #{templateName},
        #{remark},
        #{version},
        #{createDate},
        #{creator},
        #{modifyDate},
        #{modifier},
        #{status},
        #{templateType},
        #{cover},
        #{catalogs}
        )
    </insert>

    <!-- 查询所有报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectAll" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
    </select>

    <!-- 查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板名称查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateName" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATENAME = #{templateName}
    </select>

    <!-- 删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET
            TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            CREATEDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.createDate},
            CREATOR = #{reportTemplatePO.creator},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>


</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 定义所有字段 -->
    <sql id="columns">TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER,
    STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
    </sql>

    <!-- 插入单条记录 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE (<include refid="columns"/>)
        VALUES (
        #{templateId},
        #{templateName},
        #{remark},
        #{version},
        #{createDate},
        #{creator},
        #{modifyDate},
        #{modifier},
        #{status},
        #{templateType},
        #{cover},
        #{catalogs}
        )
    </insert>

    <!-- 查询所有报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectAll" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
    </select>

    <!-- 查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板名称查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateName" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATENAME = #{templateName}
    </select>

    <!-- 删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET
            TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            CREATEDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.createDate},
            CREATOR = #{reportTemplatePO.creator},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>


</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 定义所有字段 -->
    <sql id="columns">TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER,
    STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
    </sql>

    <!-- 插入单条记录 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE (<include refid="columns"/>)
        VALUES (
        #{templateId},
        #{templateName},
        #{remark},
        #{version},
        #{createDate},
        #{creator},
        #{modifyDate},
        #{modifier},
        #{status},
        #{templateType},
        #{cover},
        #{catalogs}
        )
    </insert>

    <!-- 查询所有报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectAll" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
    </select>

    <!-- 查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板名称查询报告模板 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateName" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT
            TEMPLATEID,
            TEMPLATENAME,
            REMARK,
            VERSION,
            CREATEDATE,
            CREATOR,
            MODIFYDATE,
            MODIFIER,
            STATUS,
            TEMPLATETYPE,
            COVER,
            CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATENAME = #{templateName}
    </select>

    <!-- 删除报告模板 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 更新报告模板 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET
            TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            CREATEDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.createDate},
            CREATOR = #{reportTemplatePO.creator},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新模板发布状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed',
            MODIFYDATE = #{modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{modifier}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>


</mapper>
